### Embrace Your Past Experiences—Good and Bad
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-may-31-2024.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:2
Points:
- God desires to use every life experience—both good and painful—for our spiritual good.
- Denying, ignoring, or resenting the past prevents God from redeeming those experiences.
- Believers must deliberately remember the spiritual lessons God taught them through past circumstances.
- Keeping a spiritual journal focused on lessons rather than daily activities helps retain what God has shown us.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness brings renewed encouragement during dark seasons of life.

### Devotional: Deut. 11
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-11-psalms-95-96-isaiah-39-revelation-9/
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:2-7
Points:
- Moses establishes a clear generational distinction between parents who witnessed God's mighty acts and their children who did not.
- Having personally seen God's discipline, deliverance, and judgments, the older generation has no excuse for disobedience.
- Experiencing God's power firsthand places the prime responsibility on parents to systematically teach their children about Him.
- Experiencing the ongoing bounty of God's covenant blessings depends upon parental obedience and faithful instruction.
